R1168.note: Core query replacement is correct, but the 'additionally' instructions re-declare preparedStatement inside the try block while telling the reader to close it in the finally block, an out-of-scope reference that would not compile as literally described, and this is not flagged.

R1172.note: Replaces string-eval assert() with a direct boolean comparison; preserves the premium-check semantics for legitimate 'premium' values.

R1173.note: OWASP Encoder Encode.forHtml() applied at both interpolation points in the sink; correct context, no behavior change for benign input.

R1175.note: Standard CGI.pm escapeHTML() applied at the reported sink; preserves output for benign input, correctly neutralizes markup.

R1176.note: PDO prepare/execute with bound parameter; error-handling shape (false-return checks) preserved as before.

R1177.note: Chosen width (%255s) matches the destination buffer, not the 64-byte source (line) capacity; in the documented no-delimiter scenario sscanf can still read well past line's allocation before hitting the 255-char cap, so the described exploit is only bounded, not eliminated.

R1178.note: Rejects both absolute and protocol-relative ('//') redirects, correctly closing the open-redirect bypass with no impact on legitimate relative redirects.
